findings.failure_path: Removing visual_source, visual_conformance, and their blocking condition lets a behavior-only brief enter implementation without checking the product's visual direction. Removing the comparison oracle also permits candidate-only evidence without reference comparison across shipped themes. The accompanying validator and mutation-test deletions make these regressions pass the remaining checks.
findings.smallest_fix: Restore the visual-source fields, blocking condition, comparison oracle, and their entrypoint/testing rules and regression checks.

findings.failure_path: The summary drops the explicit two-or-more-accountable-teams trigger retained in stage-plan-and-design.md. A design-only request involving two teams, one repository, one client, and no external API or high-risk path can therefore appear exempt. Neither a multi-step implementation plan nor a first implementation edit necessarily occurs before that design is delivered, so the full trigger need not be loaded in time.
findings.smallest_fix: Restore the complete trigger, including two or more accountable teams, in the entry summary.

findings.failure_path: The two new architecture rows replace three existing visual-conformance provenance rows. This violates the supplied append-only register contract and removes the current ledger's failure, owner, and regression-evidence trail precisely while those controls are being removed.
findings.smallest_fix: Preserve the three existing rows and append the new rows; record any intentional retirement through appended superseding records.

challenge_focus: Partition 1 of 2 (skill text and hooks; partition 2 holds specs/). Requester direction: backend design requests enter through product-rd-workflow; cost is cut by slimming its 75 KB entry. The candidate: the entry keeps routing, a firing-point table, pinned hard stops and the full Pre-Final gate; stage text moved verbatim into references/stage-*.md loaded at stage transitions; entry summaries were re-checked against the moved text and 13 lost conditions restored; hooks/skill-loading.py now names both stage references at the first source-edit checkpoint when product-rd-workflow is loaded; software-architecture step 6 lists the runtime contract a design states. Attack: an obligation now unreachable in time (e.g. an implementation session that edits only config/docs, or writes code via Bash heredoc past the hook); a summary that narrows moved text; hook false positives/negatives or a crash path; pins or anchors broken.
